title: Cheeses of Europe
intro: Which country is each cheese from? Origins follow Wikidata, and many foods are shared across borders, so these are single-country origins only.

questions.prompt: Which country does Pecorino Sardo PDO cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of origin of Pecorino Sardo PDO.

questions.prompt: Which country does Taleggio PDO cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of origin of Taleggio PDO.

questions.prompt: Which country does Vlašić cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Bosnia and Herzegovina as the country of origin of Vlašić cheese.

questions.prompt: Which country does Transmontano goat cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Portugal as the country of origin of Transmontano goat cheese.

questions.prompt: Which country does Fromage D'Orval cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Belgium as the country of origin of Fromage D'Orval.

questions.prompt: Which country does Queijo de Azeitão cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Portugal as the country of origin of Queijo de Azeitão.

questions.prompt: Which country does Majorero cheese PDO cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Spain as the country of origin of Majorero cheese PDO.

questions.prompt: Which country does Kefalograviera cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Greece as the country of origin of Kefalograviera.

questions.prompt: Which country does Pule cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Serbia as the country of origin of Pule cheese.

questions.prompt: Which country does Tupí cheese come from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Spain as the country of origin of Tupí.
